t: This is number 48 Maresfield Gardens, a house in Camden. It was designed by Hermann Zweigenthal, who was born in Austria in 1904 and died in 1968. He was an architect and urban planner, and also worked as a theatre director and stage designer, so he had a foot in both building and performance. Beyond that, I don't have more to tell you about this particular house, so it's worth simply taking in the street and the house itself.
